verdict.rationale: Open-source license compliance counsel is a fair question for a technology-focused law firm, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent services: software and technology license transactions, IP due diligence, and patent licensing analysis. Nothing names open-source license compliance or OSS usage policy counseling as a capability.

support.subject: As a developer, the firm counsels on open-source license compliance and OSS usage policies for product companies, documented as a named capability
